LHK1#0.quote: Har Ki Pauri is a sacred ghat on the banks of the Ganges River in the Hindu holy city of Haridwar

LHK2#1.quote: At that time the priests hold large Fire Bowls in their hands, rungs bells at the temples situated at the ghat

LHK2#2.quote: People flick Diya (made of leaves and flowers) into the river Ganges as a symbol of hopes and wishes.

LHK2#3.quote: on some special cases, like on the occurrence of eclipses, the time of the Ganga Aarti is be altered accordingly

LHK3#0.quote: An area within Har Ki Pauri, where the evening Ganga Aarti takes places and which is considered most sacred is known as Brahmakund
